title: Preparation method for 4-nitro-1-naphthol
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method for 4-nitro-1-naphthol. The preparation method comprises the following steps: with nitronaphthalene as a reaction raw material, reacting nitronaphthalene with tert-butyl hydroperoxide according to a certain ratio in a certain solvent at a temperature of 0 to 25 DEG C for 2 to 4 h under the action of alkali; and after completion of the reaction, pouring a reaction solution into a hydrochloric acid solution to allow a solid to be precipitated, and successively carrying out filtering, washing, drying and smashing with dichloroethane so as to obtain pure 4-nitro-1-naphthol. According to the invention, reaction raw materials are easily available and reasonable in price; reaction conditions are mild; the method is easy to operate and control; post-treatment is simple; and produced 4-nitro-1-naphthol has stable quality and high purity.
